summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for the HBM/AI accelerator advanced-packaging substrate and yield-enablement node. The cleanest direct substrate and surface-chemistry chokepoints identified in the external context are mostly non-US-listed or OTC-adjacent, especially Ajinomoto for ABF film, MEC Company for copper-bonding surface chemistry, and Asian substrate makers such as Ibiden, Unimicron, Kinsus, AT&S, and Shinko. For US-listed names, the better discovery lane is therefore second-order: OSAT capacity, inspection/metrology, and wafer/package test suppliers that can benefit from HBM, 2.5D/3D packaging, and yield pressure even if they do not own the substrate chemistry itself. This pass includes one reference anchor and three underfollowed or less-obvious public-market mappings.
